name: Muha Meds Live Resin Disposable | Gush Mintz
description: Gush Mints, a potent hybrid, is a remarkable creation of Kush Mints with a blend of F1 Durb and Gushers, combining the best traits of multiple beloved Cookies family strains. Gush Mints boasts a tantalizing profile of gassy and sweet terpenes, complemented by subtle piney notes. Prepare for a body-melting high that soothes the mind, leaving you in a state of pure relaxation. While productivity may take a back seat, you'll undoubtedly feel fantastic throughout the experience.
